Cercle Brugge meet KV Mechelen at Jan Breydel Stadion in round 13 of the Jupiler Pro League. Cercle Brugge are the favourite according to the odds bookmakers offered on this match, with a 48% winning probability.

Current Form - Cercle Brugge

Cercle Brugge are 14th with 12 points from 12 matches. Their record is three wins, three draws and six losses, with 15 goals scored and 22 conceded. Their last league match ended in a 1-0 win over Westerlo. Across their last five matches, they have three wins and two losses, while their run of wins stands at three matches.

Current Form - KV Mechelen

KV Mechelen are 16th with 12 points from 12 matches, level on points with Cercle Brugge but behind on goal difference. Their record is three wins, three draws and six losses, with 14 goals scored and 25 conceded. Their last league match was a 1-5 loss to Club Brugge. Their last five matches have brought three wins and two losses.

Head-to-Head Record

Cercle Brugge won one, drew one and lost three of their last five meetings with KV Mechelen, with an average of 2.6 goals per meeting. KV Mechelen were unbeaten in their last two meetings against Cercle Brugge, one win and one draw. Last season, KV Mechelen beat Cercle Brugge 3-2 at Cercle Brugge's home.
